result.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
result.summary: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge. Despite growing interest in these approaches, there has been no systematic way to evaluate how well models perform them. We introduce IWIBench, which measures a large editor model's ability to modify the weights of a smaller target model (typically Gemma 3 4B IT) to achieve one of ten classical text-editing objectives while preserving its other capabilities. Editors are limited to four tools for reading and writing weights, with bounded tensor access and a fixed budget for generating and inspecting rollouts. A validator applies each proposed patch in a clean environment and compares the edited model against the unmodified target. Evaluating frontier closed- and open-weight models reveals sharply diverging capabilities, both across models and across tasks. A small number of models, most notably Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, perform far ahead of the rest. The recency of this ability (little of it is evident in GPT-5.6 Sol, for instance), together with qualitative analysis, suggests it has been acquired through recent training. Tasks also vary widely: structured response resisted every attempt, and answer-length control yielded only one successful solution, whereas alias acquisition and recoding proved most amenable. Success in one task family correlated poorly with success in others, indicating an early and uneven capability frontier. We discuss strategies that editors repeatedly adopted and conclude with an outlook on intra-weight injection as an emerging but already potent approach to gradient-free behaviour modification.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 IWIBench，评测大模型能否在无梯度条件下直接改写小目标模型（如 Gemma 3 4B IT）的权重，以完成十类文本编辑目标并尽量保留其他能力，并给出受限读写工具、rollout 预算与独立验证环境下的结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「受限干预工具＋固定预算＋独立验证器对照未修改模型」的协议可能可供核查，用于设计对内部状态（如 latent 表示）施加改写并检验其因果作用的评测；但论文干预对象是权重而非推理期视觉状态，与 LVR 主线联系较弱。
